protocol.value:
1
Cleanse first with Obsidian Ritual.
2
Apply a small amount of Renova to clean, dry skin.
3
Massage evenly over the face and neck.
4
Use at night when the skin needs a richer recovery step.
Use Luminis for lighter daily hydration. Use Renova at night when the skin needs a richer, more conditioned finish.
